prompt: A giant, rounded, light green transparent glass perfume bottle, containing a miniature mossy valley, bonsai trees, rocks, and small waterfalls sealed inside. Placed in a brutalist raw concrete space covered by water; cold daylight enters through architectural openings from the upper left, while warm sunset light forms a rim light from the back right. The glass exhibits real refraction, caustics, tiny water droplets, and highlight distortion; the water surface creates natural reflections. Low-angle product photography, subject positioned slightly to the right, large negative space, realistic optical depth of field, high-end fragrance advertising quality, no text, no logo, no plastic CGI look.
